author: Nevernamed, Survivalaren, RattlingSnow353, Jumbocarrot, ejwu2, HEAVENBRAND, Jamie!, Vitellary (original mod)
Bender (port)
description: All in Jest v0.7.4 ported to Balatro3DS: 337 of the 626 active Jokers, plus 52 consumables (Tarots, Planets, Spectrals, Hex Tarots), 8 Tags, 8 Sidereal booster packs and the Fervent and Wood enhancements. The Astral consumable type registers but its cards wait on a pin system the fork does not have, so Sidereal packs stay inert. 84 more Jokers are rewrite-class (a later wave) and 205 are blocked on named missing engine pieces; vouchers, editions, seals and decks are all blocked (no effect seats in the fork). No license file ships with the PC mod: published with full credit and a takedown offer to the authors. Uses the Balatro3DS fork's mod API throughout (github.com/sen2008/balatro3ds-fork).
name: All in Jest (3DS port)
